name: C067 Thầy Thuốc Dịch Bệnh (Trượng Mỏ Quạ Bình Hương Y Sư)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Plague Doctor's raven-beak incense staff (Trượng Mỏ Quạ Bình Hương Y Sư - C067 Thầy Thuốc Dịch Bệnh) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete plague-doctor staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (dark walnut and riveted brass shaft) to top-right (a sculpted bronze raven-beak plague mask headpiece with a swinging perforated brass incense thurible glowing with emerald-teal healing vapor inside).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top raven-beak head and hanging censer with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use dark walnut, aged brass, blackened iron, and bright emerald-green alchemical glow).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Plague Doctor Raven-Beak Incense Staff (Trượng Mỏ Quạ Bình Hương Y Sư - C067 Thầy Thuốc Dịch Bệnh) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the raven-beak staff with its swinging brass incense censer diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a cobblestone plague-ward alley at night where luminous emerald-teal restorative incense mist billows from the swinging brass censer.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
